ruleDefinitions.name: Print History File Contents
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects events in which someone prints the contents of history files to the commandline or redirects it to a file for reconnaissance

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/cat$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/head$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/tail$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/more$")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/\\\.bash\\_history.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/\\\.zsh\\_history.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX("\\_history$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.history$") OR process_command_line = RGX("zhistory$"))))
